summary: Iteration 181 — full E2E test of the new 'Service Request → Payment Management' module (frontend priority + backend RBAC/guard-rails/payment-queue). Created fresh records end-to-end through the UI: SVC-2026-0008 (create → send_back-validation → approve → detail/timeline → Create RFQ deep-link) → SRFQ-2026-0003 (2 vendors, issue, 2 quotes, comparison with L1 highlight, recommend, selection approval) → SPO-2026-0003 (draft → submit → approve → issue) → SSRN-2026-0004 (50/50 partial, verify → approve, PO Received% = 50%) → SVI-2026-0006 (3-way match 'Matched', approve → pushed to Accounts Payment Processing Center) → verified + marked paid via /api/accounts/payment-queue (UTRUI181006) → module Payment Queue tab shows PAID + UTR, PO payment_status=partially_paid, SR timeline shows invoice_paid/payment_recorded. Mismatch path (SVI-2026-0007, gross 1.77L over entitlement) correctly routed to exception_review with red mismatch badge + mismatch dialog and remarks-gated Resolve. Backend pytest suite (19 tests) covering meta/dashboard/_id-leak, RBAC scoping + 403s, guard rails (RFQ from non-approved SR, no-vendor RFQ, send_back w/o remarks, PO before selection_approved, SRN cumulative >100%, duplicate vendor_invoice_no, exception-approve block) and payment-queue round-trip: 19/19 PASS. RBAC in UI verified as sales@erp.com: Service Procurement menu visible, can create own SR (SVC-2026-0009), sees ONLY own 2 SRs, no Review / Create RFQ / Submit Vendor Invoice buttons. Sidebar: all 6 nav-svc-* items render under 'Service Procurement' inside 'Procurement & Vendors' and navigate correctly. Dashboard: 14 KPI tiles render with counts, tiles navigate, category/requester filters work. ONE HIGH-priority functional bug found (exception invoices permanently reserve PO invoiced_total and cannot be rejected from the UI).

critical.issue: An invoice that FAILS the 3-way match (status=exception_review) still increments po.invoiced_total by its gross. On SPO-2026-0003 (total ₹1,18,000) the bogus ₹1,77,000 exception invoice pushed invoiced_total to ₹2,36,000, so the next fully legitimate invoice (₹59,000 against a freshly approved 50% SRN) was wrongly flagged 'Invoice gross ₹59,000 exceeds un-invoiced accepted value ₹0.00' and dumped into exception_review too (verified: SVI-2026-0008). The reservation is only released on invoice REJECT, and the Invoices UI offers no Reject button for exception_review rows (only 'Resolve Exception'), so Accounts can never clear it from the UI — the PO is permanently un-invoiceable, or the over-invoice has to be force-resolved into the payment queue. Fix: only reserve invoiced_total for non-exception (match-ok) invoices, or release the reservation when the exception is rejected/abandoned, AND expose Reject for exception_review invoices.

minor.issue: paid_total is null/absent while payment_status flips to partially_paid — front-end cannot show paid-vs-invoiced value. Cosmetic/data-completeness only.

ui_bugs.issue: No Reject action for invoices in exception_review — only 'Resolve Exception' (which force-moves an over-invoice to pending_approval). Backend supports action=reject; UI must expose it so the PO invoiced_total reservation can be released.

issues: React console warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent' on svc-req-form-dialog / review dialog (a11y only, no functional impact)

action_items: HIGH: Do not add exception_review invoice gross to po.invoiced_total (or release it when the exception is not resolved/approved) — currently a single bad invoice bricks all further invoicing on the PO (repro: SPO-2026-0003, SVI-2026-0007 then SVI-2026-0008).
HIGH: Add a Reject button for exception_review invoices in ServiceInvoices.jsx (backend POST /invoices/{id}/action action=reject already works and releases the reservation).
LOW: Populate paid_total on service POs alongside payment_status.
LOW: Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to service module dialogs to clear the a11y console warning.

Gate the increment on match['ok'] (or on approval) and decrement on exception abandonment.

It builds its own fresh chain each run and asserts guard rails + payment-queue round-trip. After the invoiced_total fix, re-verify: create an exception invoice on a PO, confirm po.invoiced_total unchanged, then create a valid invoice within entitlement and confirm it is 'Matched'; also confirm the new UI Reject button on exception rows. Do NOT reuse SPO-2026-0003 (its invoiced_total is corrupted at ₹2,95,000 vs total ₹1,18,000) — create a new PO.
rca_of_the_issue: create_invoice() runs the 3-way match, sets status=exception_review when it fails, but unconditionally does `db.svc_pos.update_one($inc invoiced_total: match.gross)`. The entitlement formula (total_value * accepted_pct_total/100 - invoiced_total) therefore subtracts value that was never accepted. The reservation is only reversed in invoice_action() on reject; since the Invoices UI shows only 'Resolve Exception' for exception_review rows, there is no UI path to reject → the PO's remaining accepted value stays at 0 forever and every subsequent legitimate invoice is misclassified as a mismatch (reproduced end-to-end on SPO-2026-0003 → SVI-2026-0008).
